explication: Grav is a file-based CMS and web platform. A web request enters through the front controller, is handled by the Grav runtime and its processors, and produces a rendered response. Its content model includes pages backed by filesystem storage, while configuration and structured data support site setup. Separate product capabilities include Twig and Markdown rendering, plugin/theme extensibility, package management, and scheduled jobs. The README documents the rendering and package-management capabilities; source excerpts show runtime setup and Flex storage, but do not expose the full request-to-render sequence.
